observations: Phthalimide-protected O–N substrate is converted to the corresponding free O–NH2 product.
ORD record lists hydrazine (NN), water (O), and dichloromethane (ClCCl) as reaction components.

entities.name: Hydrazine
observations: Database-supported reagent for cleavage of the N-phthalimide protecting group in this exact/core-matched transformation.

entities.name: Hydrazine aqueous DCM
observations: Recorded components are hydrazine, water, and dichloromethane; time, temperature, concentration, and yield were not reported.

entities.name: O–N phthalimide deprotection
observations: The reactant loses the N-phthalimide group and becomes a free O–NH2 hydroxylamine derivative while the ester and nitrobenzyl substituent remain unchanged.
